sources.title: Saft Sunica.plus Solar Energy Storage Battery Technical Datasheet
sources.experimental_conditions: Polar station extreme cold installation specs
sources.directly_supports: Low temperature tolerance & Ni-Cd cycle life bounds

sources.title: Cycle-life model for graphite-LiFePO4 cells
sources.authors_or_organization: Wang, J., Liu, P., Hicks-Garner, J. et al. (Journal of Power Sources)
sources.experimental_conditions: Controlled laboratory cycling at 15C, 35C, 45C, 60C and C/2 to 10C rates
sources.directly_supports: Semi-empirical LFP capacity fade mathematical formulation
sources.does_not_support: POLARIS specific cell supplier identification, calendar aging at sub-zero temperatures
sources.limitations: Requires cell-specific calibration coefficients; laboratory cell data

sources.title: A full physical-parametric lifetime model for lithium-ion batteries in stationary microgrids
sources.authors_or_organization: Schmalstieg, J., Käbitz, S., Ecker, M., Sauer, D. U. (Journal of Power Sources)
parameters_supported: Superposition of Calendar aging and Cycle aging
sources.experimental_conditions: Multi-year calendar and cycle testing matrix across SOC (10-100%) and Temp (0-55C)
sources.directly_supports: Separation of calendar and cycle aging mechanisms for stationary microgrid optimization
sources.does_not_support: Sub-zero freezing battery degradation kinetics without thermal enclosure
sources.limitations: Calibrated for 20C-45C ambient; polar stations mandate HVAC enclosure thermal stability

sources.title: NREL Battery Lifetime Analysis and Simulation Tool (BLAST) Microgrid Module
sources.authors_or_organization: Kollmeyer, P., Smith, K. et al. (NREL Technical Reports)
sources.experimental_conditions: Empirical fit to long-term microgrid cycling profiles
sources.directly_supports: Physical throughput degradation mapping to economic wear cost
